title: Michael Jackson´s Black or White
overview: A visually explosive celebration of diversity and unity, Black or White follows Michael Jackson as he moves through a series of cultures, landscapes, and dance sequences, ultimately breaking down racial barriers through music and choreography. It’s part music video, part surrealist short film, with a simple but powerful message: beneath our differences, we’re all the same.
